topic: The movie set so cursed that three actors died during production
hook: Three actors died making this movie. The curse was real.
script: Three actors died making this movie. The curse was real. During the production of The Crow in 1994, Brandon Lee was accidentally shot and killed on set. Two crew members had been seriously injured in separate incidents weeks before. A carpenter was electrocuted. A sculptor's hands were badly burned. A stuntman broke both legs. The production faced 8 major accidents. Brandon Lee died on the day his final scenes were scheduled. Follow for Hollywood sets where tragedy never stopped.
